entries.title: Jubilance IV: A Hero’s Adventure
entries.summary: Join SIT Symphonique for its annual concert celebrating music, friendship and adventure. Tickets are $5 with free seating.
entries.where: Ho Bee Auditorium, Block E3, Level 2, SIT Punggol

entries.title: CBS × AXS: Beyond the Rating
entries.organiser: SIT IAC, Credit Bureau Singapore and AXS
entries.summary: Learn how to understand your credit report, build healthy credit habits and manage bill payments. Includes a participation certificate and $5 off your first bill payment with AXS.
entries.where: SIT Punggol, Campus Court, Lectorial 7, E2-01-02

entries.title: Singapore Comic Con (SGCC) 2026
entries.organiser: SIT Rotaract and SIT Red Cross Youth
entries.summary: Support Singapore Red Cross fundraising, queues, public engagement, photography and booths. Volunteers can indicate available shifts.

entries.title: HackRift 2026
entries.summary: Teams of three to five, with solo sign-ups matched to a team. Prizes of $1,000, $500 and $250, plus food on in-person days.
entries.when: 7 to 11 December 2026; 10am to 5pm on in-person days. Registration closes 1 November 2026.

entries.title: Guiding Pathway to Success (GPS 2026)
entries.summary: CV writing, elevator pitches, company booths, networking lunch and speed mentoring with industry professionals. Open to all SIT students.

entries.title: Gardens by the Bay Visit
entries.summary: Free group visit for all SIT students, with photo and garden activities. Places are first come, first served.

entries.title: World Radiography Day 2026
entries.organiser: SIT Diagnostic Radiography and Radiation Therapy Student Management Committee
entries.summary: Celebrating ten years of radiography, with a photobooth, industry booths, merchandise, caricatures and a lucky draw for DRRT students.
entries.where: The Forum, Campus Heart, W1, Level 1

entries.title: Deepfakes & Scams: Staying Safe in the AI Age
entries.organiser: 10th Joint University Webinar, featuring SPF speaker Tay Yuanqi
entries.summary: How AI-enabled scams work, how authorities respond and how individuals can protect themselves.

entries.title: Postcards from Punggol photography contest
entries.summary: Submit a campus photograph with a caption of up to 50 words. Win shopping vouchers worth $500, $300 or $100.

entries.title: SIT Speaker Series: From Waste to Worth
entries.summary: Join Associate Professor Mark Teo and Russell Nathan to explore food waste, food resilience and practical actions for individuals and communities. Take part in a food-preservation exercise.

entries.title: Mastering the Art of Dining
entries.summary: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People offers a framework for setting priorities, aligning personal goals, managing commitments and communicating with others. Sign up on IN4SIT using activity code 0000004686. Fee: $10.
entries.where: Alumni Base Station, Block E6, Level 4

entries.title: Your Career, Your Say
entries.summary: A student survey about career pressure, portfolio building, competition and support. A $5 Grab gift voucher is offered while supplies last.
entries.when: Closes 31 October 2026; approximately 10 minutes to complete

entries.title: Shape the Future of Robotics: Robotics & You
entries.summary: Views on robotics, including acceptance, future applications and careers. Open to SIT undergraduate and postgraduate students.
entries.when: Open until 9 November; approximately 8 minutes to complete

entries.title: SkillsFuture Festival 2026 @ North East
entries.summary: Career guidance, AI and robotics showcases, more than 15 employers, local businesses and a Community AI Literacy Workshop on 28 October.

entries.title: Clean & Green Quest 2026
entries.organiser: National Environment Agency / Clean & Green Singapore
entries.summary: Teams of four complete environmental and community challenges. Limited to 25 teams; prizes are sponsored by Gain City.
entries.where: Starts at Woodlands Galaxy Community Club, with checkpoints around Kampung Admiralty

entries.title: Housing Journey Youth Panel
entries.summary: For people aged 18 to 35. Dialogues and learning journeys about housing information, support and the flat-purchase experience.

entries.title: 10 Dimensions of Wellness Series
entries.organiser: Total Wellness Initiative Singapore with the Lim Hoon Foundation
entries.summary: Explore wellbeing through crafts, panels, games and other activities. Student-community tickets are $5 using the code TWISFAMILY.

entries.title: 17th Young Hospitality Summit (YHS) 2027
entries.organiser: Young Hospitality Summit, EHL Hospitality Business School
entries.summary: For students in the final or second-to-last year of a bachelor’s degree who can communicate in written and spoken English. Connect with hospitality professionals, develop practical skills and exchange ideas with fellow students.
entries.when: Summit: 15 to 17 March 2027. Online information sessions: 6 and 13 November 2026 at 9am or 4pm CET.

entries.title: SIT Sustainability Report 2026
entries.summary: Discover SIT’s sustainability journey, progress and priorities through its first sustainability report, covering education, applied research and the Punggol campus.
